title: Best man, iv
logline: Thursday. The ribbon. Maria ties one on the dog. The dog, ten, sits for it like he's been waiting a decade to be asked.

panels.composition: Gully's, the evening before. MARIA kneeling with a ribbon. BARNABY sitting very straight. WOOD and GULLY watching.

panels.composition: The ribbon tied. The dog's face: dignity.

panels.composition: The dock at dusk. The dog in the ribbon at the end of it, sitting, looking at the water. The three humans on the steps behind him. Tomorrow.
